lessons.title: Money Is a Tool
lessons.objective: Understand that money is a tool used to exchange, save, and make choices.

lessons.title: Needs, Wants, and Tradeoffs
lessons.objective: Distinguish needs from wants and recognize that spending on one thing can mean giving up another.

lessons.title: Build a Budget
lessons.objective: Create a simple spending plan using limited resources.

lessons.title: Earn It
lessons.objective: Understand that people can earn money by providing useful work, skills, or products.

lessons.title: Save for a Goal
lessons.objective: Set a goal and compare saving now with spending now.

lessons.title: Inside the Bank
lessons.objective: Understand basic banking services and why people use savings accounts.

lessons.title: The Cost of Borrowing
lessons.objective: Understand that borrowed money must be repaid and borrowing can have a cost.

lessons.title: The Opportunity Cost Engine
lessons.objective: Identify what is given up when choosing one financial path over another.

lessons.title: Protect Your Spark
lessons.objective: Recognize common warning signs of scams and unsafe financial requests.

lessons.title: Growing Money
lessons.objective: Understand at a basic level that investments can grow or lose value and that risk matters.

lessons.title: Build a Business
lessons.objective: Understand the relationship between money earned, money spent, and profit.

lessons.title: Your Financial Future
lessons.objective: Connect repeated financial choices with long-term outcomes.
